title: Synthetic Survival Data Generation for Heart Failure Prognosis Using Deep Generative Models
summary: Official code for a paper generating and validating a privacy-preserving synthetic survival dataset for heart failure research using several deep generative models (TVAE, NFlow, ADSGAN, SurvivalGAN, TabDDPM) benchmarked mainly with the synthcity library. SDV's metadata schema (SingleTableMetadata) and sdmetrics' QualityReport/DiagnosticReport and column/table metrics are imported to define the schema and evaluate statistical fidelity and privacy of the synthetic data.
